subcommittees.name: Railroads, Pipelines, and Hazardous Materials Subcommittee

dimensions.assessment: Affects commercial motor vehicle drivers, trucking organizations, GPS navigation system producers, State departments of transportation, rental vehicle companies, and railroad carriers.
dimensions.evidence: The working group established under subsection (a) shall include representatives from... State departments of transportation; trucking organizations; producers of GPS navigation systems

dimensions.assessment: Requires DOT regulations on GPS bridge clearance information, establishes a national clearinghouse, funds research grants, and provides legal immunity to GPS administrators.
dimensions.evidence: A GPS administrator shall be immune from liability in a civil action in any court for any injury resulting from the inclusion of information on clearance heights

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes $5,000,000 for a national clearinghouse and $5,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2026 through 2030 for infrastructure research grants.
dimensions.evidence: There is authorized to be appropriated to the Secretary $5,000,000 to carry out this section. [and] There is authorized to be appropriated $5,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2026 through 2030

dimensions.assessment: Directs the Secretary of Transportation to establish a working group, issue regulations, set up a national clearinghouse, and create a research grant program.
dimensions.evidence: The Secretary of Transportation shall establish a bridge clearance strike working group... [and] issue such regulations as are necessary to implement such recommendations.

dimensions.assessment: Establishes permanent clearinghouse and regulatory frameworks alongside a five-year grant authorization spanning fiscal years 2026 through 2030.
dimensions.evidence: There is authorized to be appropriated $5,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2026 through 2030 to carry out this section.

missing_information: Total number of bridge strikes currently occurring annually nationwide.
Specific administrative costs for DOT to oversee the working group and clearinghouse.
importance_detail.rationale: The Bridges not Bumpers Act of 2025 establishes a DOT working group and subsequent regulations on bridge clearance data in GPS devices, provides $5,000,000 annually for research grants from fiscal years 2026 through 2030, authorizes $5,000,000 for a national clearinghouse, and grants civil liability immunity to GPS administrators.
